sections.h2: Commercial painting in a college town
body: Gainesville's commercial work has its own rhythm. Multi-family buildings turn over around the academic calendar, restaurants and shops cannot close for a week, and offices want the work done without employees breathing paint fumes. We handle offices, retail and restaurants, warehouses and industrial buildings, churches and schools, multi-family housing, and HOA and property-management portfolios.
Because we use our own crews rather than subcontractors, the people you meet on the walkthrough are the people running the job.

We plan commercial projects around your hours, including nights, weekends, and phased schedules. A restaurant dining room can be done after close and ready for the lunch rush. An office can be painted floor by floor. An apartment community can be phased building by building so residents are not all disrupted at once.
Low-VOC products are available for occupied interiors, and daily clean-up keeps the space usable each morning.

sections.h2: Paperwork before the first ladder goes up
bullets: Certificate of insurance naming your entity, issued before mobilization
Licensed, bonded, and fully insured in Florida, with workers' comp on every crew member
Itemized written scope: surfaces, prep, products, coats, and schedule
No changes added without written approval
Product line named so manufacturer warranties are enforceable

body: Inside, typical work includes walls, doors, frames, and ceilings in corridors and common areas, often with harder-wearing enamels where carts and traffic scuff the paint. Outside, it is stucco, block, metal doors, railings, and trim, along with concrete and masonry coatings and, where needed, anti-graffiti coatings on exposed walls.

For multi-family and association work, our apartment painting process covers unit turns and exterior cycles. Communities in Haile Plantation, Town of Tioga, and similar developments can also use our HOA and property management painting services.

A crew lead walks the site, measures, photographs conditions, and returns an itemized proposal, usually within one business day. Most projects start one to three weeks after approval. If your timeline is tied to a lease-up date, an inspection, or a grand opening, tell the crew lead at the walkthrough so the schedule on the proposal is built backward from that date rather than forward from whenever a crew is free.

Commercial exteriors also benefit from a wash before paint; our Gainesville pressure washing crews clean storefronts, sidewalks, and dumpster pads. For homes and the rest of our city coverage, see our Gainesville location page.

faqs.q: Can you paint our Gainesville office over a weekend?
faqs.a: Often, yes. Depending on size we can work nights and weekends or phase the job by floor or suite so the office stays open.

faqs.q: Will you name our association as additional insured?
faqs.a: Yes. A certificate of insurance naming your entity is available before mobilization for HOA, property management, and commercial clients.

faqs.q: Do you handle apartment turnovers between leases?
faqs.a: Yes. Multi-family work, including unit repaints and exterior repaints, is part of our commercial service.
